subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this core-owned experimental Claws lifecycle that creates agents and workspaces and records durable installation provenance?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but deciding whether agent-package lifecycle ownership, persistent provenance, and future remove/update semantics belong in core cannot be resolved from code correctness alone.

options.title: Defer pending explicit core sponsorship
options.body: Keep the stacked PR open without merge automation until a core owner confirms the lifecycle belongs in OpenClaw and defines the intended integration order.

options.title: Sponsor the staged lifecycle
options.body: Approve the core direction and review the prerequisite schema/planning PR before landing this creation-and-provenance slice.

options.title: Route the concept elsewhere
options.body: Decline the core lifecycle direction and retain only any future generic extension seam that is independently justified.

recommendation.title: Defer pending explicit core sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the stacked PR open without merge automation until a core owner confirms the lifecycle belongs in OpenClaw and defines the intended integration order.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes the proposal to this person and the unresolved choice is product ownership of the experimental core lifecycle.
